title: [SV+] Harvester Right-Sizing
description: Idle, over- and under-provisioned VMs, with a suggested size and the vCPU/memory that could be reclaimed. Based on p95 usage over the look-back window; Prometheus in the Harvester add-on keeps only 5 days.

panels.title: Summary (look-back window and thresholds are the variables above)
Running VMs
panels.description: VMs with a running instance in the selection.

targets.expr: count(max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_info{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Idle VM candidates
panels.description: Running VMs whose CPU p95, average network and average disk IOPS are all below the idle thresholds for the whole window. Candidates to power off or remove, to confirm with the owner: a VM that works only occasionally (monthly jobs) looks idle in a short window.

targets.expr: count((((100 * (quantile_over_time(0.95, (sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"}[5m])))[$window:5m])) / (count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"})))) < $idle_cpu) and on (namespace, name) ((avg_over_time((8 * (sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_network_receive_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"}[5m])) + sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_network_transmit_bytes_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"}[5m]))))[$window:5m])) / 1000 < $idle_net) and on (namespace, name) ((avg_over_time((sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_iops_read_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"}[5m])) + sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_storage_iops_write_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"}[5m])))[$window:5m])) < $idle_iops)) and on (namespace, name) max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_info{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Oversized VMs
panels.description: Running VMs whose p95 usage would fit in fewer vCPUs or less memory at the target utilisation.

targets.expr: count(((clamp_min((count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"}))) - ((clamp_min(ceil((quantile_over_time(0.95, (sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"}[5m])))[$window:5m])) / ($target / 100)), 1)) and on (namespace, name) max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_info{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"})), 0)) and on (namespace, name) max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_info{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"})) > 0 or on (namespace, name) ((clamp_min((max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_memory_domain_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"})) - ((clamp_min(ceil((quantile_over_time(0.95, (max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_memory_available_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"}) - max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_memory_usable_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"}))[$window:5m])) / ($target / 100) / 1073741824), 1) * 1073741824) and on (namespace, name) max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_info{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"})), 0)) and on (namespace, name) max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_info{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"})) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: vCPUs reclaimable
panels.description: Sum over VMs of (provisioned vCPUs - vCPUs needed for p95 CPU at the target utilisation).

targets.expr: sum((clamp_min((count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"}))) - ((clamp_min(ceil((quantile_over_time(0.95, (sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"}[5m])))[$window:5m])) / ($target / 100)), 1)) and on (namespace, name) max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_info{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"})), 0)) and on (namespace, name) max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_info{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"})) or vector(0)

panels.description: If a VM was resized inside the window its p95 reflects the old size too. CPU p95 above the under-sized CPU threshold, or guest memory p95 above the memory threshold, over the window. Check CPU Ready on the contention dashboard before adding vCPUs.
